text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, Italian food really is the best!
Pasta, risotto, Neapolitan pizza!
And for dessert, tiramisu and panna cotta!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Still, Belgian waffles are hard to pass up. And we can't forget the nata de coco♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sugar turns into energy anyway,
so it's totally fine to eat tons as long as you burn it off, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's so much food and sweets!
It all looks so delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, it's amazing that you can eat
so much and still be totally fine!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "I need to train harder too, so I can eat as much as Maruzen-san without gaining weight! I'll do my best!!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I can't let things stay like this...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Today, I'm gonna hype myself up
even more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I have to make sure I don't get looked down on by Spe-chan and everyone cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "A supercar needs speed, of course, but it's gotta have a cool silhouette too!"

Conscious of everyone's expectations,
Maruzensky successfully completed her diet.
